title: The Nature of Human Movement & Sub-disciplines

sections.heading: Defining Kinesiology and Physical Activity
sections.content: Kinesiology is the academic discipline focused on the art and science of human movement. Rather than viewing physical movement merely as mechanics or exercise, kinesiology investigates physical activity across experiential, theoretical, and professional spheres.

sections.heading: The Core Sub-disciplines
sections.content: The discipline integrates three primary pillars: Biophysical (exercise physiology, biomechanics), Behavioral (motor behavior, sport and exercise psychology), and Socio-cultural (history, philosophy, and sociology of physical activity). Each sub-discipline provides unique conceptual lenses for evaluating athletic performance, clinical rehabilitation, and lifelong wellness.

activities.desc: Interactive decision matrix mapping clinical, performance, and behavioral cases to core kinesiology sub-disciplines.
